title: Blackout Beacon — net off? Tao kotha hobe.
description: Net thakle internet diye, na thakle Beacon er nijer network diye: message pathao, manush khuje pao, nijer site share koro. Free, open source.
hero.chip: Free · Open source · Off-grid e chole
hero.sub: Ek app e message, manush ar site. Net thakle internet diye jay, na thakle Beacon er nijer network diye, dui tai thakle dui rasta-i. Account ba server lagbe na, ar net na thakleo ekta hotspot-i jothesto.
hero.meta: Phone e kichu install lagbe na. Computer er QR scan korlei cholbe.
hero.mobile.meta: Beacon computer e chole. Phone e install lagbe na, computer er QR scan korlei hobe.
off.h: Tower nai, router nai, server nai
off.sub: Beacon er kono central server nai. Shob kichu tomar nijer device e thake, tai kono infrastructure na thakleo eta chole.
off.1.d: Je kono hotspot ba router, pichone internet na thakleo, jothesto. Mobile data lagbe na.
off.2.d: Account, cloud, phone number kichui nai. Message ar site tomar device ei thake.
off.3.d: Message ar site pen drive e niye ek jayga theke arek jaygay pouchhe dao.
off.4.d: Beacon nijer installer local WiFi te share kore, tai net charai notun manush jog dite pare.
off.note: Off-grid e dourotto WiFi er range porjonto: ek ghor, ek floor, ek building. Radio bridge (LoRa, Bluetooth) pore ashbe.
reach.sub: Beacon nijei bujhe ney kon rasta khola ache. Net thakle internet diye pathay, na thakle nijer network diye, ar dui tai khola thakle dui dik diye-i.
reach.0.d: Kono network nai. Hotspot ar USB diye cholbe.
reach.1.d: Hall, basha ba office er same network. Ar kichu na thakleo eta cholbe.
reach.2.d: Tomar internet company er bhitore jara ache, tader kache.
reach.3.d: Bairer line kata, kintu desher bhitorer rasta khola.
reach.4.d: Shob khola. Message internet ar Beacon network, dui rasta-i jay.
how.1.d: Ekta file. Account ba phone number lagbe na.
how.2.d: QR scan koro, SMS e code pathao, ba phone e tin ta shobdo bole dao.
how.3.t: Net thakuk ba na thakuk, chalu
how.3.d: Net thakle internet diye, na thakle Beacon network diye. Kichu atke gele Beacon bole dey sheta kothay ache.
feat.1.d: Pouchheche, mailbox e ache, na line e opekkha korche: protibar poriskar dekhay.
feat.2.d: Notes, notice, file: ekta folder rakho, shobai browser e khulbe.
feat.3.d: Computer er QR scan koro, browser ei chat cholbe.
feat.4.d: Public IP thakle onnoder eke-oporke khuje pete shahajjo koro.
polite.h: Porichoy diye jogajog, blind scan noy
polite.body: Beacon kokhono ochena IP te knock kore na. Jader shathe tomar porichoy hoyeche, shudhu tader shathei jogajog kore.
polite.note: Mone rekho: tumi kon address e connect korcho sheta ISP dekhte pare. Message er lekha dekhte pare na.
prep.note: Net bondho hole ei page khulbe na. Tai Beacon nijer installer haate haate porer jon ke dite pare.
faq.1.a: Net thakle message internet diye jay. Na thakle WiFi ba LAN, tomar ISP er nijer line, ar desher bhitorer network: je ta khola thake sheta diye. Shob bondho hole shudhu same WiFi te cholbe.
faq.2.a: Na. Kacher computer er QR scan korle browser ei khule jay. Android app pore ashbe.
faq.3.q: Amar message ki keu porte pare?
faq.3.a: Na, message end-to-end encrypted. Internet diye gele majher relay gula shudhu encrypted lekha dekhe. Tobe ei version e forward secrecy nai: tomar key churi hole purono message pora jete pare. Ar phone diye join korle message oi computer e thake, je chalay she dekhte pare.
faq.4.a: Na. Free, open source, MIT license.
faq.5.a: Notun app e SmartScreen warning aste pare. Chalanor age publisher ar checksum miliye nao. Sign kora thakleo warning aste pare; Windows protection bondho koro na.
footer.privacy: Bhasha tomar browser ba nijer bachai theke ashe. Analytics, tracking ba country lookup nai. Font ar script ei site thekei ashe.
demo.label: Sample data diye demo
hero.mobile.sub: Ek app e message, manush ar site. Net thakle internet diye jay, na thakle Beacon er nijer network diye. Net na thakleo ekta hotspot-i jothesto.
faq.6.q: Net thakle-o ki eta kaje lage?
faq.6.a: Ha. Eta protidin er app: net thakle internet diye chole, ar net gele kichu bodlate hoy na, nijei Beacon network e chole jay.
site.notice: Beacon ekhono toiri hocche. Message, phone diye join ar off-grid delivery ekhono release hoyni. Public download ekhono nai.
site.design: Beacon jevabe kaj korar jonno toiri hocche
site.status.note: Ei page app er porikolpona dekhay. Nicher talika ekhoner build status; live network er khobor noy.
status.interface: Ek app er interface ar alada service
status.internet: Internet delivery ar Beacon network link
status.offgrid: Saved copy, USB ar fire drill
preview.caption: Interface er design preview. Manush, site ar delivery state sample data; live connection noy.
preview.title: Ekhon pouchano jay
site.no.download: Public download ekhono nai. GitHub e toirir khobor dekho.
